meta.name: agentkit-multimedia-shopping
meta.description: 基于ByteDance agentkit-samples多媒体用例的小省导购员数字人带货视频生成技能，整合多模态内容生成能力（图像、视频、音频），支持AI绘画、语音合成、视频生成，与小省导购员人设融合，9:16竖屏适配，直接对接带货视频生成流程

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带货视频，融合图像、语音和动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成带货视频并整合多模态内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate shopping videos with images, voice, and animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create product promotion videos with multimodal content

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述，生成小省导购员数字人的带货视频。它会依次生成角色形象、场景背景、语音和背景音乐，最后组合成一段25秒的竖屏视频。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频，并提到“生成带货视频”、“制作导购视频”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段小省导购员在商务会议室推销产品的视频。
say.note: Claude 会按流程生成完整的25秒带货视频。

say.text: 只生成小省导购员的角色形象图，场景用书房。
say.note: Claude 会调用AI绘画生成角色参考图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a shopping video featuring a digital avatar of 'Xiaosheng' salesperson. It sequentially creates character images, scene backgrounds, voiceovers, and background music, then combines them into a 25-second vertical video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate a digital avatar shopping video for 'Xiaosheng' salesperson, mentioning keywords like 'generate shopping video' or 'create sales video'.

say_en.text: Generate a shopping video of Xiaosheng salesperson in a business meeting room promoting a product.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a complete 25-second video.

say_en.text: Only generate the character image of Xiaosheng salesperson with a study room background.
say_en.note: Claude will call AI painting to create the character reference image.
